Post-surgery, the removal of the mass allows these mediastinal structures to return toward their normal midline alignment."}, "2046_8353801511285": {"answer": "A", "reason": "Following the excision of the mass, the post-operative image demonstrates that the heart and trachea have returned to their normal anatomical positions, and the previously compressed right lung has fully re-expanded with clear lung fields."}, "2046_8353802159168": {"answer": "B", "reason": "The lateral view (Figure 1b) localizes the mass to the posterior mediastinum, where it appears as a well-defined, lobulated opacity that compresses adjacent structures without evidence of direct infiltration."}, "2046_8353802248709": {"answer": "C", "reason": "The clinical presentation of a large, well-circumscribed posterior mediastinal mass in an adult, combined with the specific options provided, is most consistent with a pleomorphic liposarcoma."}, "2046_8353820454567": {"answer": "A", "reason": "The imaging reveals a large, lobulated mass situated in the posterior mediastinum that exerts significant mass effect, resulting in marked deviation of the trachea to the contralateral (left) side."}}
